automatic_first_minute.basis: Every actual image output in complete ID-verified archive enumerated and joined (14); every complete tool-call input inspected, no first-minute path call. Collector stripped14 image payloads consistently. This is a complete-owned-trace conclusion, not absence of collector events alone.
automatic_first_minute.scope_limit: No claim about unrecorded external viewers or screenshot pixel equivalence; repeated filenames are overwritten captures, not14 retained distinct files.

cleanup.isolated_context_meaning: tester CLI working directory, NOT a captured native Chrome profile
cleanup.historical_browser_descendant_pids: UNVERIFIED: no reliable exact browser PID receipt captured for this historical session
cleanup.actual_native_chrome_profile_path: UNVERIFIED: default chromium.launch() uses a temporary Playwright profile; no actual path receipt retained
cleanup.leftovers_conclusion: No recorded driver/tester or exact-session-path process/port remains. Independent proof that all historical browser descendants/profile paths are absent is unavailable; unrelated current browsers not attributed.

public_safety: Safe derived metadata only; no full tool strings, raw image/base64, native values, private rollout content or private original rollout path.
